ObjectName.value: Staged interior, laundry building on the grounds - Ximenez-Fatio House Museum - St Augustine, 2014-04-23 (7418)

Categories.value: Taken with Canon PowerShot G11|Ximenez-Fatio House|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR|Manually operated washing machines|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Laundry rooms in the United States|2014 in St. Augustine, Florida|Laundry equipment displays|Files from Dan Lundberg Flickr stream|Missouri Steam Washer|Household appliances in Florida

ImageDescription.value:
The staged interior of the laundry building on the grounds of the Ximenez-Fatio House Museum. The Missouri Steam Washer in the foreground was touted as ‘the best washing machine on earth’ at the time.

The house was built by a Spaniard, Andres Ximenez, in 1798. By 1830, the house had been converted to an inn.
